capabilities: Scan the active note for Markdown checkboxes via metadata cache
Render a progress bar with totals and percentage above note content
Update counts and fill bar live as tasks are toggled
Show or hide the bar via a command or hotkey
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian shows no at-a-glance progress indicator for task completion within a note.
summary: Displays a live progress bar above the active note showing completed Markdown checkbox counts and percentage, updating as tasks are toggled.
